Rashi on Yevamot 19a:10:1.hebrew: חולצות - אם מתו הנשואין את הקרובות ונפלו לפני השלישי, הרי אלו חולצות:
Rashi on Yevamot 19a:10:1.english: They perform chalitzah - If those [brothers] who were married to the relatives died and they fell [in levirate obligation] before the third [brother], these [women] perform chalitzah.

Rashi on Yevamot 19a:10:2.hebrew: ולא מתייבמות - הואיל ותרווייהו זקיקן ליה, קא פגע בקרובת זקוקתו:
Rashi on Yevamot 19a:10:2.english: And they may not enter into levirate marriage - Since both of them are bound to him [by a levirate bond], he encounters the relative of a woman bound to him.

Rashi on Yevamot 19a:10:3.hebrew: רבי שמעון פוטר - אף מן החליצה, כדקתני לקמן בשמעתין מלצרור:
Rashi on Yevamot 19a:10:3.english: Rabbi Shimon exempts - [them] even from chalitzah, as it is taught later in our sugya from [the word] "letzeror" [to be a rival wife].

Rashi on Yevamot 19a:11:1.hebrew: לייבמה לקמייתא - ההיא דנפלה ברישא. ואפי' לא הספיק לכונסה עד שנפלה אחותה, מאי איכפת לן? להוי זיקה קמייתא ככנוסה, ותיפטר בתרייתא משום אחות אשה, וקמייתא תתייבם, דכיבם אחד דומה (דהא כי נפלה מעיקרא לא נפלה אלא קמי חד, דלגבי אידך ערוה היא משום אחות אשה, ולא רמיא קמיה כלל):
Rashi on Yevamot 19a:11:1.english: Let him take the first one in levirate marriage - [That is,] the one who fell [into levirate obligation] first. And even if he did not manage to marry her before her sister fell [into levirate obligation], what does it matter to us? Let the first levirate bond be like [that of] a married woman, and let the second one be exempt because of [the prohibition of] a wife's sister, and let the first one be taken in levirate marriage, for it is like [a case of] one brother-in-law (for when she fell originally, she fell only before one [brother], since with respect to the other [brother] she is a forbidden relative because of [being his] wife's sister, and she is not cast before him at all).

Rashi on Yevamot 19a:12:1.english: With regard to the second - Who fell [for levirate marriage] last.

Rashi on Yevamot 19a:13:1.hebrew: שניה שבזוג זה - אם היו שלשה אחין, שנים מהן נשואין שתי אחיות ואשה ובתה, ומתו שניהם ונפלו לפני השלישי, אחת מן הראשונות מתייבמת ושתים האחרונות פטורות. דחדא מן הראשונות חשובה ככנוסה ומתייבמת, והשניות פטורות, אחת משום ערוה; דהי מינייהו מן הראשונות דחשבת ככנוסה, אית לה חדא קרובה בשתים השניות, נמצאת האחת יוצאת משום ערוה, ושניה משום צרתה:
Rashi on Yevamot 19a:13:1.english: The second in this pair - If there were three brothers, [and] two of them were married to two sisters and a woman and her daughter, and both of them died and [their wives] fell before the third [brother for levirate marriage], one of the first [two] is taken in levirate marriage and the latter two are exempt. For one of the first [two] is considered as already married [to him] and is taken in levirate marriage, and the second [two] are exempt, one on account of [being] a forbidden relative; for whichever of the first [two] you consider as married [to him], she has one relative among the two second [wives], so it turns out that one is exempt on account of [being] a forbidden relative, and the second on account of [being] her rival wife.

Rashi on Yevamot 19a:14:1.hebrew: וקטעי רבא בהנך ארבעה זוגי - דמתני', דס"ד דרבא דמיירי כשנפלו כולן לפני יבם אחד, מדמתרץ שניה שבזוג זה ושניה שבזוג זה. וטעות הוא בידיה: חדא, ד"או" "או" קתני — או אשה ובתה כו' — אלמא לאו כולהו בחד ביתא עסקינן:
Rashi on Yevamot 19a:14:1.english: And Rava was mistaken about those four pairs - of the Mishnah. For Rava assumed that [the Mishnah] is speaking of [a case] where they all fell before one yavam, since he answers, "the second [woman] of this pair and the second [woman] of that pair." And it is a mistake on his part: first, because [the Mishnah] teaches "or," "or" — "or a woman and her daughter," etc. — thus [it is evident] that we are not dealing with all of them in one household.

Rashi on Yevamot 19a:14:2.hebrew: ועוד - א"כ דכולהו בחד ביתא עסקינן, שהיו ג' אחים, שנים מהם נשואין שתי אחיות, ואשה ובתה, ואשה ובת בתה, ואשה ובת בנה — כל אחד נשוי ארבע נשים — ומתו ונפלו לפני השלישי, וקא"ר שמעון דאחת מן הראשונות מתייבמת והשניות פטורות, ארבעתן מיבעי ליה, דהא ד' שניות איכא:
Rashi on Yevamot 19a:14:2.english: And further - If so, that we are dealing with all of them in one household — that there were three brothers, two of them married to two sisters, and a woman and her daughter, and a woman and her daughter's daughter, and a woman and her son's daughter, each one married to four women, and they died and fell [for levirate marriage] before the third [brother], and Rabbi Shimon says that one of the first [wives] enters into levirate marriage and the second [wives] are exempt — it should have [stated] "all four of them," for there are four second [wives].

Rashi on Yevamot 19a:15:1.english: When sisters become rival wives to one another - For example, here, where they fell [for levirate marriage] before one levir.

Rashi on Yevamot 19a:15:2.hebrew: אפי' באחת מהן - אלמא תרווייהו פטורי:
Rashi on Yevamot 19a:15:2.english: Even [with] one of them - Thus, both of them are exempt.

Rashi on Yevamot 19a:16:1.hebrew: אי דנפול בזו אחר זו ה"נ - דזיקה ככנוסה דמיא, וקמייתא דנפלה מתייבמת אפילו לאחר נפילת שניה:
Rashi on Yevamot 19a:16:1.english: If they fell [before him] one after the other, indeed it is so - For [a woman under] a levirate bond is like a married [woman], and the first [woman] who fell [into the bond] may be taken in levirate marriage even after the falling of the second.

Rashi on Yevamot 19a:16:2.hebrew: כרבי יוסי הגלילי - בבכורות (יז.): רחל שלא בכרה וילדה שני זכרים, ויצאו שני ראשים כאחד — ר' יוסי אומר: שניהן לכהן, וחכ"א: אחד לו ואחד לכהן, דאי אפשר לצמצם ולצאת שניהם כאחד, אלא אחד יוצא ראשון ופוטר את הרחם, והשני חולין; ומשום דלא ידיע הי מינייהו, הוו תרווייהו ספק בכורות, ונותן אחד לכהן, והשני ירעה עד שיסתאב ויאכל במומו לבעל הבית. והכא נמי, סבר ר"ש אפשר לצמצם מיתת שני אחים כאחד, וליכא חדא דתיהוי ראשונה, ושתיהן פטורות, כדיליף טעם מלצרור; דאי לאו כר' יוסי הגלילי, הויא לה חדא ראשונה, ולא ידיע הי מינייהו, ותרווייהו ליבעו חליצה:
Rashi on Yevamot 19a:16:2.english: In accordance with Rabbi Yosei HaGelili - In Bekhorot (17a): [If] a ewe that had not previously given birth bore two males, and two heads emerged simultaneously — Rabbi Yosei says: Both belong to the kohen; and the Sages say: One belongs to him [the owner] and one to the kohen, because it is impossible to be exact and have both emerge simultaneously; rather, one emerges first and exempts the womb [from firstborn sanctity], and the second is non-sacred. And because it is not known which of them [emerged first], both are of doubtful firstborn status, so he gives one to the kohen, and the second grazes until it develops a blemish and is eaten with its blemish by the owner. Here too, Rabbi Shimon holds [that] it is possible to be exact [regarding] the death of the two brothers [occurring] simultaneously, so there is not one [woman] who becomes the first, and both are exempt, as he derives the reason from [the word] litzror ("to be a rival"). For if it were not in accordance with Rabbi Yosei HaGelili, one [of them] would be the first, and it would not be known which of them [it is], and both would require chalitzah.

Rashi on Yevamot 19a:17:1.hebrew: רב פפא - לעיל מהדר ופליג אדרבי אושעיא, ותרווייהו בבי דמתני' לרבנן איצטריכו, לאשמועי' דרבנן בתרווייהו פטרי. ודקא קשיא לך: בבא דרישא למה לי? פשיטא דבנולד ולבסוף ייבם פטרי:
Rashi on Yevamot 19a:17:1.english: Rav Pappa - He refers back to [what was stated] above and disagrees with Rabbi Oshaya, and both clauses of the Mishnah were needed for the Rabbis, to teach us that the Rabbis exempt [her] in both [cases]. And as for what is difficult for you: "Why do I need the first clause, [since] it is obvious that where [the brother] was born and subsequently [the other brother] performed levirate marriage, they exempt [her]?"

Rashi on Yevamot 19a:18:1.hebrew: לא זו אף זו קתני - כלומר, אשמועינן ברישא נולד ולבסוף ייבם, והדר תנא ייבם ולבסוף נולד, לומר לך דלא זו בלבד דנולד ולבסוף ייבם פטורה, אלא אף דייבם ולבסוף נולד נמי פטורה:
Rashi on Yevamot 19a:18:1.english: It teaches, "Not [only] this, [but] also that" - That is to say, it informed us first [of the case where a brother] was born and afterward [another brother] performed levirate marriage, and afterward it taught [the case where he] performed levirate marriage and afterward [the brother] was born, to tell you that not only [where he] was born and afterward performed levirate marriage is she exempt, but even [where he] performed levirate marriage and afterward [the brother] was born, she is also exempt.

Rashi on Yevamot 19a:19:1.hebrew: כוותיה דרב פפא - דמודי ר"ש בנולד ולבסוף ייבם:
Rashi on Yevamot 19a:19:1.english: In accordance with Rav Pappa - That Rabbi Shimon concedes in [a case where the brother] was born and afterward [the other brother] performed levirate marriage.

Rashi on Yevamot 19a:19:2.hebrew: ועמד השני כו' - לקמן פריך, למה לי למיתני עמד ולא הספיק:
Rashi on Yevamot 19a:19:2.english: And the second [brother] was about [to perform levirate betrothal], etc. - Later [the Gemara] asks: Why do I need [the baraita] to teach, "[he] was about [to do so] and did not manage"?

Rashi on Yevamot 19a:19:3.english: And the second [woman] - The wife of the second [brother].

Rashi on Yevamot 19a:1:1.hebrew: מבית אחד - ורחמנא אמר את בית אחיו (דברים כ״ה:ט׳), בית אחד הוא בונה, ואינו בונה שני בתים:
Rashi on Yevamot 19a:1:1.english: From a single house - And the Merciful One said, "[who will not build] his brother's house" (Deuteronomy 25:9) — he builds one house, and he does not build two houses.

Rashi on Yevamot 19a:1:2.hebrew: ולמיפטרה אידך - דזיקה ככנוסה דמיא, וכ"ש זיקה ומאמר:
Rashi on Yevamot 19a:1:2.english: And to exempt the other - [One might think so] because a levirate bond is considered like a married [woman], and all the more so a levirate bond and ma'amar [levirate betrothal].

Rashi on Yevamot 19a:20:1.hebrew: עשה בה מאמר כו' - חולצת, דלא אלים מאמר לשווייה צרת ערוה למיפק בולא כלום:
Rashi on Yevamot 19a:20:1.english: He performed levirate betrothal with her, etc. - [The second wife] performs ḥalitza, because levirate betrothal is not strong enough to render her the rival wife of a forbidden relative so as to be released with nothing.

Rashi on Yevamot 19a:2:1.hebrew: גזירה שמא יאמרו שתי יבמות הבאות משני בתים - ונפלו בבת אחת בצמצום, דליכא למימר שהראשונה הוזקקה לבעל השניה, ואתי למימר נמי תתייבם חדא ותיפטר אידך:
Rashi on Yevamot 19a:2:1.english: A decree lest they say: Two yevamot who come from two households - and they fell [into the levirate bond] simultaneously, at the exact same moment, such that one cannot say that the first became bound to the husband of the second, and [people] will come to say as well: let one be taken in levirate marriage and the other be exempt.

Rashi on Yevamot 19a:3:1.hebrew: משום מאמר ולא מאמר - ספק מאמר קונה, ספק אינו קונה:
Rashi on Yevamot 19a:3:1.english: Due to levirate betrothal or not levirate betrothal - [It is] uncertain [whether] levirate betrothal acquires [her], [or] uncertain [whether] it does not acquire [her].

Rashi on Yevamot 19a:5:1.hebrew: ביבם אחד - כגון מתני' דהוו שני אחין, וכי מיית חד, זקוקה להאי לחודיה ורמיא עליה. הלכך, אע"פ שלא כנסה עד שנולד השלישי, הוה ליה כייבם ולבסוף נולד:
Rashi on Yevamot 19a:5:1.english: When [there is] a single yavam - Such as [the case of] our Mishnah, where there were two brothers, and when one died, she is bound to this [surviving] one alone and falls to him [for levirate marriage]. Therefore, even though he did not marry her until the third [brother] was born, it is considered as if he performed levirate marriage and [the third brother] was born afterward.

Rashi on Yevamot 19a:5:2.hebrew: אבל בשני יבמים - כגון הך דשלשה אחין דפשו להו תרי, לא:
Rashi on Yevamot 19a:5:2.english: But [when there are] two yevamim - Such as this [case] of three brothers where two remain, [it is] not [considered like a married woman].

Rashi on Yevamot 19a:6:1.english: And does he differentiate - and permit [it] in [the case where] he was born and afterward [the brother] performed levirate marriage?

Rashi on Yevamot 19a:6:2.hebrew: והתניא - כל שהלידה של שלישי קודמת לנישואין של שני, לא חולצת. אלמא מודה ר"ש בהא:
Rashi on Yevamot 19a:6:2.english: But it is taught - Whenever the birth of the third [brother] precedes the [levirate] marriage of the second [brother], she does not perform ḥalitza. Thus, Rabbi Shimon concedes in this [case].

Rashi on Yevamot 19a:7:1.hebrew: מאי לאו ביבם אחד - שכשמת ראשון, לא נשאר אלא אח אחד, ואח"כ נולד זה:
Rashi on Yevamot 19a:7:1.english: What, is it not [referring to] a single yavam - That when the first [brother] died, only one brother remained, and afterward this [other brother] was born.

Rashi on Yevamot 19a:7:2.hebrew: לא בשני יבמין - שהיו שלשה אחים ומת אחד מהן, ונפלה לפני השנים, ונולד להם אח. ההיא ודאי אסירא עליו דהאי בתרא, אפילו לאחר שייבמוה שנים הראשונים ומתו, דהא ודאי נולד ולבסוף ייבם הוא; דההיא זיקה דהויא לה גבי הני קודם לידתו של זה, לא אלימא לשוויה ככנוסה למהוי כייבם ולבסוף נולד:
Rashi on Yevamot 19a:7:2.english: No, with two yevamin - [That is,] where there were three brothers, and one of them died, and she fell [for levirate marriage] before the [remaining] two, and [then] a brother was born to them. That [woman] is certainly forbidden to this latter [brother], even after the first two performed levirate marriage with her and died; for this is certainly [a case of] "he was born and afterward he performed levirate marriage," since that levirate bond (zikah) that she had with these [brothers] prior to the birth of this [latter brother] is not strong enough to render her like a married woman so as to be [considered] like [a case of] "he performed levirate marriage and afterward he was born."

Rashi on Yevamot 19a:9:1.english: The entire [baraita] is dealing with two yevamin - Regarding two yevamin, [it] seeks to teach us prohibition and permission.

Rashi on Yevamot 19a:9:2.hebrew: אלא מאי כללא - הואיל וביבם אחד אפילו לידה קודמת לנישואין שרי, היכי מצי למיתני כל שהלידה קודמת לנשואין לא חולצת ולא מתייבמת, וקתני כלל א"ר שמעון? הא זמנין דלא הוי הכי:
Rashi on Yevamot 19a:9:2.english: Rather, what is the principle - Since with one yavam, even [when] the birth [of the brother] precedes the marriage, she is permitted [to him], how can [the baraita] teach, "Whenever the birth precedes the marriage, she neither performs chalitzah nor enters into levirate marriage," and state, "Rabbi Shimon stated a general principle"? Behold, there are times when it is not so.

Tosafot on Yevamot 19a:10:1.hebrew: ועוד מתיב רב אושעיא - כאן מוכיח כפר"ת דרבי אושעיא לאו היינו רב אושעיא, דההיא דפ' הדר בעירובין (ד' סח. ושם) דקסבר התם ר' אושעיא דאין ברירה; ובפרק בתרא דביצה (ד' לז: ושם) אית ליה לר' אושעיא ברירה:
Tosafot on Yevamot 19a:10:1.english: Moreover, Rav Oshaya raised an objection - Here it is proven, in accordance with the explanation of Rabbeinu Tam, that Rabbi Oshaya is not [the same as] Rav Oshaya, for [in] that [passage] of the chapter [entitled] HaDar in Eruvin (68a, and there), where Rabbi Oshaya holds there that there is no retroactive designation [bereirah]; whereas in the last chapter of Beitzah (37b, and there), Rabbi Oshaya holds [that there is] retroactive designation [bereirah].

Tosafot on Yevamot 19a:2:1.hebrew: שמא יאמרו שתי יבמות כו' - פירש בקונט' שנפלו בבת אחת, כר' יוסי הגלילי דאמר אפשר לצמצם. ועי"ל כגון שהראשונה היא ערוה לאחיו השני שמת, שלא היתה זקוקה לו כלל:
Tosafot on Yevamot 19a:2:1.english: "Lest they say: Two yevamot, etc." - Rashi explained [that this refers to a case] where they fell [for yibbum] simultaneously, in accordance with Rabbi Yosei HaGalili, who says [that] it is possible to be exact [in timing]. And one can also say [that it is a case] such as where the first [woman] is a forbidden relative to his second brother who died, so that she was not bound to him at all.

Tosafot on Yevamot 19a:3:1.hebrew: והא טעמא דר"ש משום מאמר ולאו מאמר הוא דתניא וכו' - הו"מ לשנויי דלדבריהם דרבנן קא"ל:
Tosafot on Yevamot 19a:3:1.english: But Rabbi Shimon's reason is due to [whether] levirate betrothal [is valid] or not, as it is taught, etc. - [The Gemara] could have answered that he was speaking to them according to the Rabbis' own view:

Tosafot on Yevamot 19a:3:2.hebrew: דתניא אמר להם ר"ש כו' - והא דאמר בפ' ר"ג (לקמן יבמות נא:) דר"ש סבר דמאמר קונה קנין גמור — היינו לענין שאין ביאה ומאמר אחריו, אבל לא עביד לה ככנוסה:
Tosafot on Yevamot 19a:3:2.english: "As it is taught [in a baraita]: Rabbi Shimon said to them, etc." - And [as for] that which [the Gemara] states in the chapter [entitled] Rabban Gamliel (below, Yevamot 51b), that Rabbi Shimon holds that ma'amar [levirate betrothal] effects a complete acquisition — that is [only] with respect to [the law] that there is no [validity to] intercourse or ma'amar after it, but it does not render her like a fully married woman.
